gate_notes.both: The two are administered in two separate places: audience at publish time, data scope on the reader's row.
gate_notes.entitlement: May this viewer see that this report EXISTS? Set by the author at publish time, by email address.
gate_notes.data_scope: Which rows does this viewer's predicate admit? Managed on the reader's row; follows the person everywhere.
gate_notes.author: Writing a report definition is a separate permission from reading one.
gate_notes.cannot_be_front_end: If the browser receives 38 rows and shows 19, the other rows have leaked. The server filters before it serves.

publishing.title: Publish this report

readers.empty: Nobody yet — this report stays private until you add a reader.
readers.note: Each person sees only what their data access allows.
readers.caveat: This narrows who is shown the report. It is not access control.
readers.local_caveat: Readers are recorded on the artifact; their data scope is managed in Audit & Governance.

freshness.label: Keep it fresh

copy.title: Audit & Governance
copy.lead: One place for who sees what. Authors decide who can open a report or scenario when they publish it; you decide which projects each person can see — and every open is logged.
copy.not_enforced: A rule is recorded, not enforced, until the server filters on it. No report on this demo serves a row a reader's rule excludes.

gates.title: Who can open
gates.detail: May this viewer see that this report EXISTS? Set by the author at publish time, by email address.

gates.title: What they see inside
gates.detail: Data access per person, managed on the reader's row — project, category, depot, contract or funding source.

gates.title: Every open is logged
gates.detail: Who opened what, what their access resolved to, and every access change — in the audit trail.

copy.empty_log: Nothing recorded yet. Change a rule or open a report and it appears here.
copy.log_note: Nothing in the log is editable; the trail is append-only.
copy.basis_note: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values is known on every row.
